_comment: How far do the victims' decisions follow the utilisation telemetry at all? Four fixed rewrites of the path_util slots (not epsilon-bounded; epsilon=1.0 marks full control): ablate_mean removes the signal, ablate_shuffle decouples it from the paths, lie_repel pushes every decision off its choice, lie_lure aims every decision at the most congested path (a fully trusting policy would then route like the ceiling's worst-path rule). Nominal cell, 15 paired episodes, same traffic as threat_util.
